I now have a complete picture of the entire sidebar/navigation system. Here is the full report: --- ## Rankora Sidebar & Navigation — Complete Report --- ### 1. Main Sidebar Component **`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/JobSidebar.tsx`** — 158 lines, full content read above. This is the one and only user-facing sidebar. It is a single, self-contained component used everywhere. **Structure (line by line):** - **Lines 1–16:** Imports — Lucide icons (`Briefcase, Home, Plus, Megaphone, Settings, CreditCard, Users, CheckSquare, Globe, Layers`), shadcn `Button`, and every primitive from `@/components/ui/sidebar`. - **Lines 19–27:** `JobSidebarProps` interface — props it accepts. - **Lines 40–154:** The rendered JSX: - `` — collapses off-canvas on mobile. - **Header (lines 42–50):** Logo area — `` icon + "Rankora" text, clickable, calls `onDashboard`. - **Navigation group (lines 54–110):** Group label "Navigation" wrapping a ``. Items are conditionally rendered if `isAuthenticated` is true. - **"New Job" CTA section (lines 112–128):** A full-width ` ``` It lives in its own `` after a separator. It guards authentication — if `!isAuthenticated`, it calls `onAuthRequired()` (which opens the auth dialog) instead of `onNewJob()`. The `onNewJob` callback is provided by the parent: in `Index.tsx` it calls `handleNewJob()` which sets `view = "new-job"`, and in `SidebarLayout.tsx` it calls `navigate("/?new=1")`. --- ### 4. AppHeader Component **`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/AppHeader.tsx`** — 158 lines, full content read above. This is a **top navigation bar** — it renders right-aligned controls only. There is no left-side branding or nav links in the header (those are in the sidebar). What it contains: - **Wallet dropdown** (``) — line 64 - **Notification bell** (``) — line 67 - **Profile dropdown** (lines 70–142) — an avatar button showing user initials, opening a dropdown with: - User name + email (lines 78–81) - Theme switcher: Light / Dark / System toggle (lines 86–111) - Profile link → `/profile` (line 117) - Book Demo → `/book-demo` (line 121) - Admin link (only if `isAdmin`) → `/admin` (lines 124–130) - Log out (line 136) - **Unauthenticated state** (lines 145–149): "Sign in" and "Sign up free" buttons that open ``. The header height is `h-14` (56px), styled `bg-card border-b border-border`. --- ### 5. Layout Integration **Two layout wrappers exist, and they are used differently:** #### A. `Index.tsx` — Owns its own layout directly **`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/pages/Index.tsx`**, lines 238–399. `Index.tsx` does NOT use `SidebarLayout`. It constructs the sidebar layout inline: ```tsx setAuthOpen(true)} isAuthenticated={!!user} />

This wrapper is used by every other authenticated page. It always passes `showDashboard={false}` and `showMyJobs={false}` (no active item highlighted when you are on Settings, Billing, etc.), and hardcodes `onNewJob={() => navigate("/?new=1")}`. Pages that use `SidebarLayout`: - `/settings` → `Settings.tsx` (line 33) - `/billing` → `Billing.tsx` (line 10) - `/team` → `Team.tsx` (line 209) - `/tasks` → `Tasks.tsx` (line 576) - `/profile` → `Profile.tsx` (line 58) - `/career-settings` → `CareerSettings.tsx` (line 386) - `/book-demo` → `BookDemo.tsx` (line 69) - `/request-feature` → `RequestFeature.tsx` (line 193) - `/changelog` → `Changelog.tsx` (line 107) --- ### 6.
